comments.value: We have a Japanese sign language community. I want you to add Japanese sign language to the list of language for the profile. Thank you!

日本手話を是非、言語一覧に加えて頂きたく思います
宜しくお願いします

FYI: ISO 639-3 code of Japanese Sign Language is "jsl" (https://iso639-3.sil.org/code/jsl).
So "[ jsl ] Japanese Sign Language" should be suitable.

I might ask somebody who did languages for me.
I let you know if we have some answer for it.
JSL is now included in the language selection.

details: Hello! I would like it if you can add Japanese Sign Language to the list of languages for the profile. Thank you.
title: Add JSL
